propositions: The documented curl command uses git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg which resolves to the shared hooks directory from any worktree, causing overwrites of the pre-commit wrapper in the main checkout rather than worktree-local installation.

Pre-commit runs in migration mode with the Gerrit stamper installed as commit-msg.legacy, but the curl command replaces the wrapper entirely, breaking the Change-Id chaining and making failures silent until git push gerrit rejects commits.

The fix centralizes hook installation into make hooks and scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh to be idempotent, non-destructive, worktree-safe, and offline-testable using git rev-parse --git-common-dir for absolute resolution.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove instructions for the bare curl command and direct users to make hooks instead.
The installer refuses to overwrite non-wrapper commit-msg hooks with a nonzero exit and validates fetched payloads contain Change-Id logic before installation.
Existing Change-Id stamping is detected and treated as idempotent, avoiding repeated installations on make install cycles.
